rows.grounds: compound name formed from bhava and rudra
past passive participle naming the depicted form
indicates the universal scope of the function
first member indicating what is destroyed
agent noun expressing the function of the named form

items.question: What name and universal function are attributed to this depicted form?
premises: The depicted form is designated Bhavarudra.
This form is the destroyer of worldly-becoming.
This destructive function extends to all beings.
items.inference: Therefore the depicted form is identified as Bhavarudra, the universal destroyer of worldly-becoming.
items.plain_english: He is called Bhavarudra, the destroyer of worldly existence for all.
